name: Ikaruga Gargouille Risette
original_name: 斑鳩 ガルグイユ・リゼット
source:
A third-year student in the Pillar. She is marked with the sign of Cancer.

Last year, Risette made a bid for the presidency of the student council as a candidate of St. Leanne's [i]de facto[/i] ruling Blood Pact Party, only to be defeated by her rival Konoe. 

She is currently serving as the council's vice president under the older Saginomiya's leadership. 

[Based on [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221024151940/http://www.virgo-resistance.sakura.ne.jp/watamari/]two[/url] separate [url=https://x.com/fenrirvier/status/2009865553901695245]descriptions[/url] provided by the author.]
